purpose: The query set of the retrieval measure (stage 37a, decision AW40): questions an agent might ask of the corpus and of the compiler, each with the definition it targets (the map's qualified name) and the project it is indexed in. Written by hand, paraphrasing the purposes rather than copying them; a few quote a line of code.

queries.query: how is a percentage discount applied to an invoice and the result rounded to whole cents
add up the amounts of every line before any discount
count the weekdays between two dates, leaving weekends out
which tasks fall due within the next few days, the nearest first
topological sort of build steps that breaks ties alphabetically
print an arithmetic tree in infix form with parentheses
the recursive size of a directory on disk
which products need reordering because their stock fell to the reorder level
increase an item's quantity when a delivery comes in
bucket the error lines of a log by hour and count them
split one log line into its timestamp, its level and its message
the widest cell of each column, for aligning a table
keep requesting pages while the response carries a next_cursor
which of the required permissions no role grants
retry an action, waiting about twice as long after each failure
can this version stand in for the required one: same major and not older
pick the highest version out of a list
find the shape with the biggest area
check that round and square brackets are nested properly
the middle value of a sorted list of numbers
the next state of a traffic light, where an emergency overrides the normal cycle
how often each word occurs, case-insensitive, most frequent first
use the default configuration when the config file cannot be read
exchange an amount into another currency at today's rate
how many extra kilogram steps a parcel's weight adds to its price
escape a string the way Rust's {:?} prints it, quotes and backslashes included
register a module's declared names before anything is resolved
find a type by its name in the module, among the exposed imports or in the prelude
what fix is proposed for an unknown type name
the position of a variant in its sum type, looked up by name
does the type of an implementation satisfy what the ability requires
does a granted capability cover a needed one, by ancestor path and scope
turn a needs clause of the syntax tree into a grant
compile every module of a checked project into the program of one bytecode file
build a token carrying the integer code of its kind
replace the element at an index of a list, unchanged when the index is out of range
parse a lexed text into a module, with the comments set aside
resolve a program's imports transitively, its own files and its dependencies
is a literal an absolute URL with a scheme and a host
the line and column of a character offset in a text
the text that renyi check prints, each fix under its diagnostic
the Renyi spelling of a type name from another language, such as int or string
does a type contain a given type parameter anywhere
the spelling of a reserved word from its code, for an error message
check a top-level constant's value against its declared type
